description: Fixed virtual right-wrist camera for the focused DexYCB mug replay. This is a visualization placement, not a measured sensor calibration. Camera moves rigidly with the wrist; it does not track the object.
reference_state: Measured q in log.npz; exact robot prefab FK across the full 43.3 s replay. Mug framing near the intended grasp is secondary to hand visibility.

fit.note: Projection bounds cover robot finger joint origins and fingertips. Mesh occlusion is possible; a cup that falls away is not guaranteed to remain in view.
